item.title: TailwindSQL – Like TailwindCSS, but for SQL Queries in React Server Components
item.description:
📝 TailwindSQL 🎨 Like TailwindCSS, but for SQL queries in React Server Components. TailwindSQL lets you write SQL queries using Tailwind-style class names. Just use className to query your database directly in React Server Components.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/mmarinovic/tailwindsql
